summary.headline: Moon–Mercury Applications by Sign
summary.text: Astrological delineations for the Moon’s application after separation to Mercury in Virgo, Libra, and Scorpio, interpreting conjunction, sextile, square, trine, and opposition. Predictions concern winds, weather, markets, merchants, rulers, nobles, children, physicians, astrologers, calculators, and secretaries.
